Giles County, Virginia Tax Sales: A Simple Guide to Buying Property at Auction

Giles County, Virginia hosts public tax sales to collect unpaid property taxes. These auctions give you the chance to purchase real estate at a lower price while helping the county recover tax revenue. If you’re thinking about joining a tax sale, here’s a clear overview of how the process works.

Click Here to Get Dustin Hahn’s Tax Lien and Deed FREE Mini-Course

When Giles County Holds Tax Sales

Giles County schedules tax sales only when needed—there’s no set date every year.

  • Auction Frequency: As needed, not annually
  • Recent Example: One auction took place on May 24, 2024
  • Where to Check Dates: Visit the county’s tax sale page or check the Auction Calendar

What to Expect During a Tax Sale

Before you bid, it’s important to understand the steps from registration to final payment.

  • Auction Location:
    • Most sales happen in person at the Giles County Courthouse
    • Address: 501 Wenonah Avenue, Pearisburg, VA 24134
  • Auction Time:
    • Start time varies; check the auction listing for exact details
    • All times follow Eastern Time (ET)
  • Registration Requirements:
    • You must register before the auction
    • The sale notice provides registration steps and deadlines
  • Redemption Period:
    • Property owners can pay off what they owe anytime before auction day
    • Once the sale happens, they lose the right to redeem the property
  • Bidding and Payment Process:
    1. Highest bid wins
    2. You must pay the full amount and deed recording fees right after the auction
    3. Accepted payments: personal checks, money orders, cashier’s checks, or traveler’s checks
    4. Cash is not allowed

Where to Stay Updated on Sales

Keep checking for upcoming auctions here:

  • Giles County Treasurer’s Tax Sale Page – Official updates and sale listings

Contact Information for Help

If you have questions about tax sales, contact the Treasurer’s Office:

  • Phone: (540) 921-1240
  • Address: 130 North Main Street, Pearisburg, VA 24134
  • Email: Not publicly listed—call directly for assistance

Quick Tips for a Smooth Auction Experience

Make your auction day successful by keeping these tips in mind:

Hilly terrain is common—check if the land can support your intended use.

Many listings here are legacy properties—confirm there’s no active family claim.

Look for parcels with creek access; they often attract outdoor enthusiasts.
